    EXEC('CREATE DATABASE demo_lakehouse COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8');

-- Generated from specs/sources/customers.yaml
-- Bronze = schema-on-read view over every raw file ever loaded. All columns VARCHAR, no cleaning.
-- Columns are at least VARCHAR(50) so a bad value never breaks the read; silver rejects it instead.
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW bronze.customers AS
SELECT
    r.customer_id,
    r.first_name,
    r.last_name,
    r.email,
    r.country,
    r.signup_date,
    r.filename()                AS _source_file,
    CAST(r.filepath(1) AS DATE) AS _ingest_date
FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'customers/ingest_date=*/customers.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'ds_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        FIELDTERMINATOR = ','
     )
     WITH (
        customer_id  VARCHAR(50),
        first_name   VARCHAR(100),
        last_name    VARCHAR(100),
        email        VARCHAR(255),
        country      VARCHAR(50),
        signup_date  VARCHAR(50)
     ) AS r;

-- Generated from specs/sources/customers.yaml
-- business_key: [customer_id]
-- Silver = typed, trimmed, DQ-checked, de-duplicated Parquet in curated/silver/customers/run_id=<id>/.
-- Each pipeline run writes a NEW run_id folder, so CETAS never hits "folder not empty".

-- Block 1: typed values + DQ flags (one helper view reused by the clean and rejects tables)
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW silver.customers_checked AS
WITH typed AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(customer_id)), '') AS INT)   AS customer_id,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(customer_id)), '')                    AS customer_id_raw,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(first_name)), '')                     AS first_name,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(last_name)), '')                      AS last_name,
        LOWER(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(email)), ''))                   AS email,
        UPPER(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(country)), ''))                 AS country,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(signup_date)), '') AS DATE)  AS signup_date,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(signup_date)), '')                    AS signup_date_raw,
        _source_file,
        _ingest_date
    FROM bronze.customers
)
SELECT
    t.*,
    -- reject rules: one CASE each, producing '<rule_name>;' when the row fails
      CASE WHEN t.customer_id IS NULL                                      THEN 'customer_id_not_null;'  ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.customer_id IS NULL AND t.customer_id_raw IS NOT NULL    THEN 'customer_id_valid;'     ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.first_name IS NULL                                       THEN 'first_name_not_null;'   ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.last_name IS NULL                                        THEN 'last_name_not_null;'    ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.email IS NULL                                            THEN 'email_not_null;'        ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.email IS NULL OR t.email NOT LIKE '%_@_%._%'             THEN 'email_format;'          ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.country IS NULL                                          THEN 'country_not_null;'      ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN LEN(t.country) > 2                                         THEN 'country_max_length;'    ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.signup_date IS NULL                                      THEN 'signup_date_not_null;'  ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.signup_date IS NULL AND t.signup_date_raw IS NOT NULL    THEN 'signup_date_valid;'     ELSE '' END
      AS _dq_failures,
    -- no warn rules in the spec; the column keeps the same shape as the other silver tables
    CAST('' AS VARCHAR(500)) AS _dq_warnings
FROM typed AS t;

text.value:
-- Block 3: clean rows, one per business key (latest ingest wins; ties broken by row hash)
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE silver.customers
WITH (
    LOCATION    = 'silver/customers/run_id=@{pipeline().RunId}/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ds_curated,
    FILE_FORMAT = ff_parquet
)
AS
WITH hashed AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(64), HASHBYTES('SHA2_256',
            CONCAT_WS('|', c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.country, c.signup_date)), 2) AS _row_hash
    FROM silver.customers_checked AS c
    WHERE c._dq_failures = ''
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT h.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.customer_id ORDER BY h._ingest_date DESC, h._row_hash DESC) AS _rn
    FROM hashed AS h
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    CAST(country AS VARCHAR(2)) AS country,
    signup_date,
    _dq_warnings,
    _row_hash,
    _source_file,
    _ingest_date,
    CAST('@{pipeline().RunId}' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS _batch_id,
    SYSUTCDATETIME()                  AS _processed_ts
FROM ranked
WHERE _rn = 1;

-- Block 5: rejects = rows that failed at least one reject rule (all columns kept for investigation)
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE silver.customers_rejects
WITH (
    LOCATION    = 'silver/customers_rejects/run_id=@{pipeline().RunId}/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ds_curated,
    FILE_FORMAT = ff_parquet
)
AS
SELECT
    c.*,
    CAST('@{pipeline().RunId}' AS VARCHAR(64)) AS _batch_id,
    SYSUTCDATETIME()                  AS _processed_ts
FROM silver.customers_checked AS c
WHERE c._dq_failures <> '';

-- Generated from specs/sources/orders.yaml
-- business_key: [order_id]
-- It is file 02 because the warn rule customer_exists reads silver.customers, which is built by file 01.
-- Silver = typed, trimmed, DQ-checked, de-duplicated Parquet in curated/silver/orders/run_id=<id>/.
-- Each pipeline run writes a NEW run_id folder, so CETAS never hits "folder not empty".

-- Block 1: typed values + DQ flags (one helper view reused by the clean and rejects tables)
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW silver.orders_checked AS
WITH typed AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(order_id)), '') AS INT)             AS order_id,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(order_id)), '')                              AS order_id_raw,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(customer_id)), '') AS INT)          AS customer_id,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(order_date)), '') AS DATE)          AS order_date,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(order_date)), '')                            AS order_date_raw,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(product)), '')                               AS product,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(quantity)), '') AS INT)             AS quantity,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(quantity)), '')                              AS quantity_raw,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(unit_price)), '') AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS unit_price,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(unit_price)), '')                            AS unit_price_raw,
        UPPER(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(status)), ''))                         AS status,
        _source_file,
        _ingest_date
    FROM bronze.orders
)
SELECT
    t.*,
    -- reject rules: one CASE each, producing '<rule_name>;' when the row fails
      CASE WHEN t.order_id IS NULL                                         THEN 'order_id_not_null;'     ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.order_id IS NULL AND t.order_id_raw IS NOT NULL          THEN 'order_id_valid;'        ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.customer_id IS NULL                                      THEN 'customer_id_not_null;'  ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.order_date IS NULL                                       THEN 'order_date_not_null;'   ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.order_date IS NULL AND t.order_date_raw IS NOT NULL      THEN 'order_date_valid;'      ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.product IS NULL                                          THEN 'product_not_null;'      ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.quantity IS NULL                                         THEN 'quantity_not_null;'     ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.quantity IS NULL AND t.quantity_raw IS NOT NULL          THEN 'quantity_valid;'        ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.quantity < 1                                             THEN 'quantity_min;'          ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.unit_price IS NULL                                       THEN 'unit_price_not_null;'   ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.unit_price IS NULL AND t.unit_price_raw IS NOT NULL      THEN 'unit_price_valid;'      ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.unit_price < 0                                           THEN 'unit_price_min;'        ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.status IS NULL                                           THEN 'status_not_null;'       ELSE '' END
    + CASE WHEN t.status IS NULL
             OR t.status NOT IN ('PLACED', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED', 'RETURNED')
                                                                           THEN 'status_allowed;'        ELSE '' END
      AS _dq_failures,
    -- warn rules: same shape, but the row stays in silver
      CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM silver.customers AS r WHERE r.customer_id = t.customer_id)
                                                                           THEN 'customer_exists;'       ELSE '' END
      AS _dq_warnings
FROM typed AS t;

activities.name: gold_01_customer_order_summary
activities.description: Runs sql/gold/01_customer_order_summary.sql (1 block(s)) on database demo_lakehouse

scripts.text:
-- Generated from specs/models/customer_order_summary.yaml
-- grain: one row per customer_id
-- Gold = plain views over silver external tables. Views are always current: no data is copied.
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW gold.customer_order_summary AS
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.first_name + ' ' + c.last_name                                  AS full_name,
    c.email,
    c.country,
    c.signup_date,
    COUNT(o.order_id)                                                 AS total_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity), 0)                                      AS total_quantity,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity * o.unit_price), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS total_revenue,
    MIN(o.order_date)                                                 AS first_order_date,   -- NULL when no orders
    MAX(o.order_date)                                                 AS last_order_date     -- NULL when no orders
FROM silver.customers AS c
LEFT JOIN silver.orders AS o
       ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
      AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED'           -- filter in the ON clause so customers without orders are kept
GROUP BY
    c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.country, c.signup_date;
